data_fields.name: check_haptic_vs_move_haptic
data_fields.donor_constant: medium impact for check, light impact otherwise

best_idea: Warn once per fighter when a timed resource falls to a fraction of its starting budget, latch the warning in the same step as the cue, and re-arm the latch whenever the budget is reset.
decision_why: Keep the 10 percent latched warning and the re-arm rule, decide the warning in the tick rather than in a render, and make the threshold a fraction of the budget (data) instead of the donor's fixed 8 s; the donor's expiry latch never re-arms, which the sketch fixes.
acceptance: A fighter whose stamina or fight timer drops under ten percent hears one low-stamina sting, not one per frame; after a reset or a new round the sting can play again; a client test drives a tick sequence through the threshold and asserts exactly one cue per budget.
